title: Paloma and the Ember
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Yara Underhill, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
